$comment: The one table of the speakers SoundTap knows, by model and by hardware variant (ADR 0008).
Edit this file, then run `go generate ./internal/modeltable` in app/ (os/support/models_gen.py
other copy to it: the init script, soundtapd's model profiles, installer.c, the STU builder and
checker, the boot recipes, U-Boot's model detection, the device trees and the image's /boot.
models: what MODEL names. variant is the board's own variant; module_suffix the suffix of the
STU modules it takes (soundtap-kernel.<suffix>); spl and uboot the suffix of the boot chain it
takes; kernel_name what the uImage header names after 'Linux-6.12 SoundTap '; stock_rootfs_limit
the largest ubi.img Bose's installer streamed to it; mfg_product the product name at 0x170 of
NAND.Manufacturing-Data that U-Boot reads, null when U-Boot tells the board apart otherwise;
variant_raw the recorded range of U-Boot's variant_raw (hex digits), null when none is recorded.
variants: what /proc/variant and variant= on the kernel command line say. model is the MODEL it
runs as; product the name /api/info reports; dtb and kernel what the slot recipes load from
/boot; dts the source tree the dtb is built from; codec_script the speaker's own codec script,
null on a board without a codec; stock_only a name only stock firmware reports, which no recipe
of ours writes, so it has no dtb, kernel or tree.
boot_images: where the build leaves each SPL and U-Boot, by suffix, under output/os/images.
